title: GameCreate
responsibility: Create an app or dimensional game through the local host and open its resulting workspace.

inputs.name: GameCreate.bridge
inputs.description: An optional `DesktopBridge` whose `gameCreate` method enables project submission and takes precedence over the window host. When omitted, the component reads `window.harness` on mount; without a `gameCreate` function, the form remains disabled.

inputs.name: GameCreate.created
inputs.description: An optional callback invoked with the returned project snapshot after `gameCreate` succeeds. If omitted, the component performs a full-page navigation to `/harness` for apps or `/game?projectId=...` for games; callback exceptions are caught and shown in the form alert.

outputs.name: GameCreate
outputs.description: Renders a form that trims the project name, offers app/game selection, and offers 2D/3D selection only for games; submission is disabled while busy, when the name is empty, or until the active bridge has `gameCreate`. On success it calls `created(snapshot)` when provided or navigates to the app/game destination; errors from creation, the callback, or destination handling are caught and shown in the alert.

errors.name: MissingProjectIdError
errors.description: Thrown with the message `The new game came back without a project id.` when opening a newly created game without a `created` callback and `snapshot.project.id` is missing or empty. `submit` catches it and displays `errorMessage(cause)` in the form alert.
